attributes.title: Scalable Data Warehouse for LLM Fine-tuning: API Design for High Throughput Data Ingestion and RAG Retrieval
attributes.summary:
This project aims to make  customer support services better by using AI to generate text in
Amharic, Swahili, and Yoruba. We created systems that can generate quick and relevant
responses in Amharic languages based on customer questions and past interactions.
To achieve this, the technology is required to have quality amharic text embedding. In order to do
that, we  chose a suitable open source LLM model and fine-tune it further to deliver the business
objective.
Steps to achieve the business needs.
1. Data Pre-processing: clean, tokenize
2. Fune-tuning an open source LLM with Amharic data in order to generate ads
3. build RAG System: Retrieval ads with provided brand or products in Amharic
